name: Gloomdelve
desc: A roguelike built for one thumb: swipe to step or tap to walk through generated dungeon floors, where every move gives the monsters a turn. Sleeping monsters wake to noise, archers need a clear line of sight; death is permanent, but the embers you earn buy upgrades for the next run. Ten generated floors end in a boss fight with the Gloom Warden, with 9 monster types, 6 runes, 6 relics and fog of war, a daily delve with the same dungeon for everyone, and an Ember Shrine of permanent upgrades. No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no network use after the first load; installable as a PWA that works offline.
controls: Swipe to step, tap to walk — one thumb; embers earned on runs buy Ember Shrine upgrades between delves
creator: Apurba94
